facts.fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency published the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2023/24-2026/27 in February 2023, with a four-year implementation plan costed at N$58,995,000 across ten sector statistics plans; the document gives no separate adoption date, so its publication date is used.

note: The document is the statistics agency's own institutional plan, stated to be distinct from the national statistics development strategy (NSDS), so it gives no strategy fact.

facts.fact: PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2023-2027.
Namibia Statistics Agency names the Namibia Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2023/4-2026/7 as the country's national strategy.

note: Only a bare SPI finance score; names no strategy.

facts.fact: The Windhoek Observer reports Namibia's NSDS is being implemented by the national statistics authority over the 2023/24 to 2026/27 financial years with an estimated budget of N$58.9 million.
